note: M1 vectors. Truth discipline (data/README.md §4.3): a vector stores the INPUT plus the EXPECTED result, and the test recomputes the expectation instead of trusting a stored string. Check-digit rows carry data digits + the official complete vector; the expected digit is re-derived from data_digits by gs1/checksum.py on every test run.

algorithm.quote: weight = data_len % 2 == 0 ? 3 : 1; ... parity += weight * (data[pos] - '0'); weight = 4 - weight; ... parity = (10 - parity % 10) % 10;
algorithm.rule: the starting weight is decided by the parity of the length INCLUDING the check digit (even -> 3, odd -> 1), then alternates left to right; the alternate weight is 4 - W (not 6 - W); only data positions are summed

rule.quote: DST: if (GS1_LINTER_UNLIKELY(DD > maxdd)) /* Permit "00" */ ... UNIT_TEST_PASS(gs1_lint_yymmd0, "200600"); /* dd=00 permitted */
rule.semantics: YYMMDD with DD=00 permitted, meaning the last day of that month; the month must be 01..12; the day is checked against a leap-year-aware month length
rule.canonical_form: data/README.md §3 (yymmd0 章节) 与 §8.1 之后的日期口径
